name: Saruwatari Hiroshi
source: Hiroshi is a man whose wife and child left him after discovering his hidden hobby of voyeurism. Currently, he works at a management company run by his relatives and serves as the building manager for the apartment complex where Subaru and his friends live. Unable to quit his voyeuristic tendencies, he secretly recorded the activities of Seina and Sae.
